name: How much does it cost to add a basement to a custom home in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost impact of adding a basement or subterranean level?
mainEntity.text: What is the cost impact of adding a basement or subterranean level?

acceptedAnswer.text: A basement can be one of the most expensive parts of a custom home because it requires excavation, soil hauling, shoring, waterproofing, drainage, and stronger structural design. In Los Angeles, subterranean construction is especially sensitive to lot conditions, access, and nearby structures. A basement may be worthwhile when the lot is constrained or when extra living, storage, or utility space is valuable, but it should never be priced like normal above-grade square footage. Homeowners should ask whether the basement is fully included in the estimate and whether the budget covers finish level, waterproofing system, and any necessary mechanical ventilation. On difficult sites, the basement decision can have a major impact on both cost and schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adding a basement can significantly increase the cost because of excavation, waterproofing, shoring, structural engineering, and ventilation requirements. In Los Angeles, subterranean space is often much more expensive than above-grade square footage, especially on tight or sloped lots.
